title: The Last Songbook
author: Orsen Vane
blurb: Petra Blackwood, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
